name: Twilio MCP and Skills
description: Searches Twilio docs and API specifications from coding agents through a hosted MCP server, plus agent skills for SMS, Voice, Verify and SendGrid.

skills.name: Search Docs and APIs
skills.description: Searches Twilio, SendGrid and Segment docs and API operations by natural-language query, returning ranked results and IDs.

skills.name: Retrieve API Schemas
skills.description: Retrieves full parameter and response schemas for chosen Twilio API operations so agents write exact requests.

skills.name: Product Planner Skills
skills.description: Guides product choices, such as Twilio Verify versus a custom OTP, before code is written, through planner skills.

skills.name: Product Skills
skills.description: Walks coding agents through sending SMS, verifying users with OTP codes and sending SendGrid email with Twilio.

skills.name: Guardrail Skills
skills.description: Applies security hardening, reliability and A2P 10DLC compliance patterns that keep Twilio integrations from failing.
